fields.statement: QA at bbfe87e3 with a built binary (go build -trimpath) in a scratch Rhiza root and project, real git config, no fakes: rhiza health with defaults: autonomy ok, no phrase. After git config rhiza.autonomy.plan auto and rhiza.daemon.permissionMode bypassPermissions: exit 0, 'warn autonomy plan auto, accept auto, ship auto, signoff auto; outside text reaches agents with no permission checks', detail lines 'workflow plan runs from a queued request with bypassed permissions in interview, review, critic, revise, arbiter' and the ship-change one (accept/ship default auto), next rhiza guide workflows; --json autonomy state warn. With rhiza.daemon.paused true: 'daemon paused; ...' plus the phrase, next stays rhiza daemon set rhiza.daemon.paused false. permissionMode acceptEdits: ok, no phrase, no workflow lines.

QA at bbfe87e3 with a built binary (go build -trimpath) in a scratch Rhiza root and project, real git config, no fakes: With plan auto + bypassPermissions (accept/ship auto) health and workflow check flag plan (trigger request; interview, review, critic, revise, arbiter) and ship-change (trigger ready; build/build builder and verifier, every review check, critic, fixer, verifier, ci-fix, arbiter). With plan owner + bypass, request --ref notes plan only (per decision outside-input-plan-owner-not-intake). With acceptEdits nothing is flagged anywhere.

QA at bbfe87e3 with a built binary (go build -trimpath) in a scratch Rhiza root and project, real git config, no fakes: rhiza workflow check plan with no bypass: 'workflow plan is valid (builtin:plan)', no warning. With plan auto + bypassPermissions: exit 0, valid line plus '  warning: workflow plan runs from a queued request with bypassed permissions in interview, review, critic, revise, arbiter: outside text reaches agents with no permission checks'; --json valid true, problems [], warnings holds that line. ship-change gets its warning only while plan, accept and ship are all auto; acceptEdits clears it.

QA at bbfe87e3 with a built binary (go build -trimpath) in a scratch Rhiza root and project, real git config, no fakes: With plan auto + bypassPermissions: rhiza request --ref https://example.com/i/1 'Add a thing' exits 0, prints 'Queued feature request ...' then one 'Note: outside text reaches agents with no permission checks in workflow plan, ship-change (rhiza guide workflows)'; --json has the note field; request ls lists the queued requests; a request without --ref prints no note; --dry-run with --ref notes and queues nothing. plan owner + acceptEdits with --ref: no note.

QA at bbfe87e3 with a built binary (go build -trimpath) in a scratch Rhiza root and project, real git config, no fakes: rhiza guide workflows prints the '## Outside input' section: warns on request text and --ref reaching an autonomous bypassPermissions workflow, every queued request counts, Rhiza cannot see what a scheduled rhiza request sends, nothing refused; says rhiza.autonomy.plan owner does not gate intake; mitigations: people not schedules queue requests, narrower rhiza.daemon.permissionMode or step permission_mode, plan owner and rhiza.autonomy.signoff owner for what runs after.
